_doc: Merged over every grade on the web / Compatibility profile (C2): no colour-correction LUT there, so the selective desaturation and the split tone go, and a map's own `web` block (a plain saturation) stands in. `post` (T-208, the U09 section 2d budget): the browser keeps the one-tap pieces of the post stack (grain, vignette, the menu's flicker) and drops the edge softness and the chromatic aberration (the 4-6 extra screen taps at the frame edge); the pass is then one screen read and one tap a pixel.
